scope: speed only; no shoulder work; no SP-078 verdict; no SP-079 rating

source_snapshot.note: Counts and proof-of-concept calculations were reproduced from the available SQLite snapshot.

the_show_speed_vs_statcast_sprint_speed.population: 47 players in the existing lower-bound mlb_bridge × the_show_bridge intersection
the_show_speed_vs_statcast_sprint_speed.values: multi-year averages; not same-time player-year observations
the_show_speed_vs_statcast_sprint_speed.interpretation: The Show Speed carries substantial physical-speed signal in this bounded historical bridge, but time mixing and selection prevent direct current-NPB conversion.

npb_common_metric_neighborhood_to_powerp.validation: 5-fold GroupKFold by proeye_id; the same player never appears in both train and test
npb_common_metric_neighborhood_to_powerp.interpretation: Even basic shared NPB indicators contain enough signal to reconstruct a substantial portion of historical PowerPro rating behavior. This validates an analog/behavior-QA lane, not a physical-speed teacher.

npb_common_metric_supervised_screen.interpretation: Model choice changes performance, so route uncertainty and ablation must be explicit. Nonlinear models are screening tools until temporally held-out and player-clustered QA passes.

required_role_separation.physical_latent_path: must remain PowerPro-label-free and must not use The Show as direct measurement
required_role_separation.game_appraisal_behavior_path: may model The Show and PowerPro rating behavior from common indicators
required_role_separation.decision_use: compare independent physical estimate, The Show-implied appraisal, PowerPro-behavior expectation and contextual evidence; never replace the physical estimate with a game label

mandatory_caveats: The existing 47-player bridge is a lower-bound selected sample and uses multi-year averages.
Basic batting/baserunning outcomes mix physical speed, technique, opportunity, batting quality, park and managerial usage.
League-season percentile normalization and opportunity controls are mandatory before MLB↔NPB analog matching.
Speed, Stealing and Baserunning Aggressiveness must remain separate latent traits.
A poor analog match must remain missing or wide-range; no forced nearest neighbor is allowed.
PowerPro labels describe historical game appraisal behavior and cannot serve as physical ground truth.
The Show edition effects must be modeled separately rather than pooled without controls.

decision.next_step: Build player-year common-feature panels for MLB and NPB, perform mutual-nearest-neighbor/optimal-transport matching with balance diagnostics, and emit player-specific analog receipts plus route-ablation QA.
